dialogue.origin: こんにちは相談員ですよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Pleased to meet you.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのようなご相談ですか
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 振られてしまって辛くてどうしていいかわかりません
dialogue.content: I was dumped, and I'm in so much pain that I don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: それはお辛いですね
dialogue.content: That must be very painful for you.

dialogue.origin: どうしていいか分からなくなりますね
dialogue.content: It's understandable to feel lost about what to do.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お別れになられたのはいつですか
dialogue.content: When did you break up?

dialogue.origin: 先週です
dialogue.content: Last week.

dialogue.origin: 先週・・・まだ日が浅いと辛すぎますね
dialogue.content: Last week... Since it's still so recent, it must be overwhelmingly painful.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どの位のお付き合い期間だったのですか
dialogue.content: How long were you together?

dialogue.origin: 10年です
dialogue.content: Ten years.
Ten years!

dialogue.origin: 10年のお付き合いに先週ピリオドを打たれては辛い気持ちでいっぱいですよね
dialogue.content: Having a ten-year relationship end just last week must leave you overwhelmed with pain.

dialogue.origin: もう死にたいくらいです
dialogue.content: I feel like I want to die.

dialogue.origin: 何も手に付かない、その事しか考えられないですよね
dialogue.content: You can't get anything done; it's all you can think about, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 生きてたくない気持ちは痛いほど理解できます
dialogue.content: I can deeply understand the feeling of not wanting to live.

dialogue.origin: 差し支えなければどの様なことがお別れの理由でしたか
dialogue.content: If you don't mind me asking, what was the reason for the breakup?

dialogue.origin: いきなりだったのではっきりとした理由はわかりません
dialogue.content: It was so sudden that I don't know the exact reason.

dialogue.origin: いきなり10年のお付き合いにピリオドは辛すぎる
dialogue.content: For a 10-year relationship to end so suddenly, it's just too painful.

dialogue.origin: 何も考えられない状態ですよね
dialogue.content: You must be in a state where you can't think clearly, right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 相談前は何をなさっていらっしゃいましたか
dialogue.content: What were you doing before this session?

dialogue.origin: 泣いていました。
dialogue.content: I was crying.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 泣いても泣いても涙はかれないですよね
dialogue.content: No matter how much you cry, the tears just don't stop, do they?

dialogue.origin: もう疲れました
dialogue.content: I'm exhausted.

dialogue.origin: 泣き疲れましたか？考えつかれましたか？
dialogue.content: Are you tired from crying? Or tired from thinking?

dialogue.origin: 両方です
dialogue.content: Both.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね・・・そのことで頭も心もいっぱいですよね
dialogue.content: I understand... Your mind and heart must be completely filled with it.

dialogue.origin: これからどうやって生きていったらいいかわかりません
dialogue.content: I don't know how I'm supposed to go on living.

dialogue.origin: そんな気持ちになられるのは当然です
dialogue.content: It's completely natural to feel that way.

dialogue.origin: 10年の重みや重ねた時間はそんなに軽いものではないです
dialogue.content: The weight of 10 years and the time you spent together is not something to be taken lightly.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 先週から今日のご相談まで他に誰かとお話ししましたか
dialogue.content: Between last week and our session today, have you spoken with anyone else about this?

dialogue.origin: 友達には話しました。でもまだあまり人に話せる気持ちになれません
dialogue.content: I talked to a friend, but I'm still not really in a state of mind to talk to people about it.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね・・・辛すぎるお話しは話せる気持ちにはなりにくいですよね
dialogue.content: I understand... When something is this painful, it's hard to feel like talking about it.

dialogue.origin: 差し支えなければ年代を伺ってもよろしいですか
dialogue.content: If you don't mind, may I ask your age range?

dialogue.origin: 30代です
dialogue.content: I'm in my 30s.

dialogue.origin: 30代でいらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: I see, you're in your thirties.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それでは、お付き合いも将来をみすえたものであってのでは？
dialogue.content: In that case, was your relationship one where you were looking toward the future?

dialogue.origin: はい、結婚するかはわからなかったけど、ずっと別れたくなかったです
dialogue.content: Yes. I wasn't sure if we'd get married, but I never wanted to break up.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね・・・10年のお付き合いが永遠に続くとおもいますよね
dialogue.content: I see... After 10 years together, you'd think it would last forever, wouldn't you?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご飯など召し上げっておられますか
dialogue.content: Have you been able to eat?

dialogue.origin: 食欲もあまりありません
dialogue.content: I don't have much of an appetite.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね・・・食欲もなくて当然ですよ
dialogue.content: That's understandable. It's natural to lose your appetite.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: その事だけがこの一週間頭と心でいっぱいですものね
dialogue.content: For this past week, that's been the only thing filling your mind and heart, hasn't it?

dialogue.origin: 他にはなにも考えられないですよね
dialogue.content: You can't think about anything else, can you?

dialogue.origin: ええ、もう何も考えられません
dialogue.content: No, I can't think about anything else.

dialogue.origin: 毎日毎日、24時間いっぱいな感じですよね
dialogue.content: It feels like it's occupying you 24 hours a day, every day, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: お別れの事とこの先の絶望感
dialogue.content: The breakup and the feeling of hopelessness about the future.

dialogue.origin: ああ、そういうことですね。はい
dialogue.content: Ah, I see what you mean. Yes.

dialogue.origin: 一瞬でも頭や心から離れる時はどんな時ですか
dialogue.content: When are the moments, even for an instant, that it leaves your mind or heart?

dialogue.origin: 考えないとき
dialogue.content: The times when you're not thinking about it.

dialogue.origin: わずかに寝ている時くらいです
dialogue.content: Only when I'm sleeping, and even then, just barely.

dialogue.origin: 仕事もコロナで激減してるので
dialogue.content: My work has also decreased drastically because of COVID.

dialogue.origin: 寝ている時だけが考えないですむ時間なのですね
dialogue.content: So sleeping is the only time you get a break from thinking about it.

dialogue.origin: 気を紛らわす時間も少ないかんじでおられると・・・
dialogue.content: So it sounds like you have little time for distractions...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 10年間という長い期間のお付き合いに急にお別れがきて
dialogue.content: After a long 10-year relationship, the breakup came so suddenly,

dialogue.origin: 絶望で生きて居たくないくらい追い詰まっていらっしゃるのですよね
dialogue.content: and you feel so cornered by despair that you don't want to live, is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 寝ている時だけが唯一考えないで済む時間だと
dialogue.content: You mentioned that sleeping is the only time you don't have to think about it.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 起きている時はずっと考えてしまいますか？
dialogue.content: Do you find yourself thinking about it constantly when you're awake?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: I suppose so.

dialogue.origin: 一秒たりとも頭、心から離れる瞬間はありませんか？
dialogue.content: Is there not even a single second when it leaves your mind or heart?

dialogue.origin: 1秒たりともっていうのも、、、
dialogue.content: Well, to say 'not even a single second' is a bit...

dialogue.origin: 一秒の時間はとっても大切な事と思います
dialogue.content: I believe even a single second is very important.

dialogue.origin: すみません
dialogue.content: I'm sorry.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ、、、
dialogue.content: No, no...

dialogue.origin: 今、この10年のお付き合いの重みに急にお別れがきて
dialogue.content: Right now, with the weight of a ten-year relationship ending so suddenly,

dialogue.origin: その事で整理もつかず生きてたくない位頭も心もいっぱいにうめつくされている
dialogue.content: you're unable to process it, and your mind and heart are so completely filled with it that you don't even want to live.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: でも、一瞬、ほんの1秒でも考えない時間が出来るということは
dialogue.content: But, the fact that there's a moment, even just one second, when you're not thinking about it...

dialogue.origin: 他の事が頭をよぎった瞬間ですよね
dialogue.content: ...means that something else crossed your mind in that instant, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 泣いて泣いて、考えるのもつかれ生きていくのも嫌になるくらい追い詰まってらっしゃる
dialogue.content: You've cried and cried, you're tired of thinking, and you're so cornered that you feel like you don't want to live anymore.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: でもその他に気をとられた1秒が2秒、3秒になると
dialogue.content: But if that one second of distraction becomes two seconds, or three seconds,

dialogue.origin: 今考えてる事から違う思いも生まれてくるのではと感じました
dialogue.content: I feel that different thoughts might begin to emerge from what you're currently thinking about.

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれないですね
dialogue.content: That might be true.

dialogue.origin: その2秒、3秒が他の違う思いで気持ちの変化が出来ていければとも感じます
dialogue.content: I also feel that if those two or three seconds become filled with different thoughts, your feelings could start to shift.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ずっと寝て現実逃避することもできないでしょうし
dialogue.content: You probably can't just sleep all the time to escape reality,

dialogue.origin: コロナで少なくなったとおっしゃるお仕事もしないわけにはいかないのが現実なのかなと
dialogue.content: and the reality is that you likely have to do your job, even though you mentioned there's less of it due to COVID.

dialogue.origin: 仕事はオファーがあればもっとしたいです。したくないわけではありません
dialogue.content: I'd like to work more if there were offers. It's not that I don't want to work.

dialogue.origin: 今抱えている深い傷つきを2秒、3秒から1分違う事が考えられたら今の暗闇から抜け出せるきっかけがお仕事にスライドしていけたら良い感じですか
dialogue.content: So, if being able to think about something else for even a minute could be a catalyst to escape your current darkness, do you think that catalyst could be your work?

dialogue.origin: ごめんなさいお仕事のオファーが少なくなった事も今の思考の原因でしょか
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, is the lack of work offers also contributing to your current state of mind?

dialogue.origin: 仕事がコンスタントにあれば、考え込む時間も少ないかもしれません。
dialogue.content: If I had work consistently, I might have less time to dwell on things.

dialogue.origin: そうですか！！
dialogue.content: I see!

dialogue.origin: 今の深い傷つきの痛みもお仕事をなさっていればそちらに集中できそうなのですね
dialogue.content: So it sounds like if you were working, you could concentrate on that and distract yourself from the deep pain you're feeling now.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: ご提案なのですが
dialogue.content: In that case, I have a suggestion.

dialogue.origin: 仕事に集中なされば考え込む時間も少なくなるとの事
dialogue.content: You mentioned that if you could concentrate on work, you'd have less time to dwell on things.

dialogue.origin: では、お仕事のオファーについて考える時間をあえてもってみるのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So, how about we purposefully take some time to think about work offers?

dialogue.origin: はあ
dialogue.content: Hmm?

dialogue.origin: 見当はずれなようでしたね・・・
dialogue.content: It seems my suggestion was off the mark...

dialogue.origin: 失礼いたしました
dialogue.content: My apologies.

dialogue.origin: オファーを増やすことを考える時間を持つっていうことですか？
dialogue.content: Do you mean setting aside time to think about how to increase offers?

dialogue.origin: 増やすことではなく
dialogue.content: Not about increasing them,

dialogue.origin: どうしたら考える時間を少なくできるか。というご提案でした
dialogue.content: my suggestion was about how you could reduce the time you spend dwelling on this.

dialogue.origin: 折角、気力もないのにお話ししてくださったのにお力になれす不快な思いをさせてしまったようで申し訳ありません
dialogue.content: You took the time to talk to me even when you have no energy, and I'm very sorry that I couldn't be of help and seem to have made you feel uncomfortable.

dialogue.origin: いいえ、そんなことありません
dialogue.content: No, that's not it at all.

dialogue.origin: 自分で解決して乗り越えたいんですが、辛すぎて。
dialogue.content: I want to solve this and get over it on my own, but it's just too painful.

dialogue.origin: 時間が解決してくれるのかもしれません
dialogue.content: Maybe time will heal it.

dialogue.origin: そうですよねですからご相談にきてくださった
dialogue.content: I understand. And that's why you came to talk today.

dialogue.origin: はい、1秒の積み重ねが1分、10分1時間となられる事を願っています
dialogue.content: Yes, I hope that those single seconds will build up to a minute, then ten minutes, and then an hour.

dialogue.origin: 私もそう願いたいです
dialogue.content: I want to hope for that too.

dialogue.origin: お時間とともに傷もいやされ希望を持たれる事を祈っております
dialogue.content: I pray that, with time, your wounds will heal and you'll find hope.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 力不足ですみませんでした今日はありがとございました前進出来る事祈っております
dialogue.content: I'm sorry I wasn't more helpful. Thank you for your time today. I'm praying that you'll be able to move forward.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: (共感不足ですみませんでしたありがとうございます修了でよろしいですか)
dialogue.content: (I'm sorry for my lack of empathy. Thank you. Shall we conclude the session?)

dialogue.origin: (ありがとうございました。もっと突っ込んで欲しかったです！ありがとうございました)
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much. I would have liked you to delve deeper! Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: (教えていただきありがとうございます！訓練していきます。ありがとうございました又、お会い出来たらよろしくお願いいたします)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for the feedback! I'll continue to train. Thank you. I hope to see you again.)

dialogue.origin: (終了ボタン押してください。またよろしくお願いいたします)
dialogue.content: (Please press the end button. Let's do this again sometime.)

topic.sub: 10年の交際後の突然の別れによる心の痛み
